algorithm: Weighted scoring per SWOT quadrant (sum of weight x score), then TOWS pairing of top factors into SO/WO/ST/WT actions.
complexity: O(F) over F factors; sorting for top factors is O(F log F).
data_flow_ascii:
seeded factor lists -> build_factors (weight, score per factor)
factors -> score_quadrant -> quadrant totals -> dominant quadrant
top factors -> tows_actions -> SO / WO / ST / WT action items
quadrants + actions -> render_matrix -> ASCII 2x2 matrix
description_sentence: A SWOT and requirements analyzer that scores seeded factor lists per quadrant, finds the dominant quadrant, and generates TOWS action items.
failure_note: Empty factor lists score zero and yield a 'no factors' note instead of a crash, so partial input still renders.

label: swot_analyzer
output_shape: Prints an ASCII 2x2 SWOT matrix with quadrant scores and a numbered list of TOWS action items.
pitch_sentence: I built a {topic} that scores SWOT quadrants and turns the top factors into concrete TOWS actions.

qa.a: Each factor gets a weight and a 1-5 impact score; the quadrant total is the sum of weight times score.
The highest-scoring quadrant is the dominant one; the matrix also shows whether internal or external factors lead.
Strengths with Opportunities, Weaknesses with Opportunities, Strengths with Threats, Weaknesses with Threats.

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} in Python with weighted SWOT quadrant scoring and TOWS action-item generation.
run_notes: --factors sets how many seeded factors land in each quadrant.
scaling_note: The math is trivial at any factor count; real use is in workshop facilitation, not computation.
storage_note: No persistence: factors are regenerated from the seed each run.
tradeoff_note: Seeded factors make a reproducible demo; real analysis needs human judgment to name and weight factors.
